{{Wireless adapter |brand=PESI |model=WP222M |revision=A1 |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=04/25/2002 |manuf_country= |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |if=PCMCIA (16-bit) |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=PQP-WP222MF00001 |ic_id= |chip1_brand=ShareWave |chip1_model= |chip2_brand=RFMD |chip2_model= |chip3_brand=RFMD |chip3_model= |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=b |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui=00:06:F4 |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This device uses the '''ShareWave''' (later bought out by '''Cirrus Logic''') Bodega chipset. The cards support 802.11b and ShareWave's proprietary Whitecap2 protocol. [http://www.thefreelibrary.com/PESI+Develops+Family+of+Wireless+Home+Networking+Products+Based+on+...-a085161915]
The Windows 98SE/ME/2000/XP driver (rescued from Zayetech's website via the WayBack Machine) can be downloaded [http://wikidevi.wi-cat.ru/files/ShareWave/Bodega/WP222M_Driver&Utility_USA_36.zip here].
"1000WP222M01-A1" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
It is highly probable that this card is RF3000 + RF2948B based (same as the C2 revision).
